text:
amar: quick sync — I'm proposing we split endpoint responsibilities: keep endpoint-operator to lifecycle/ENI/route plumbing and introduce a separate controlplane-rotator to handle cert rotation and the mutual auth handshake.
lee: +1 on narrowing operator RBAC. main risk is ordering during cutover — atomic handoff needed so traffic doesn't hit endpoints with stale certs.
maria: can you sketch the state machine and failure modes? retries if rotator fails mid-rollout are critical.
amar: rough state machine:
1) controlplane creates Endpoint (state: Provisioned)
2) rotator requests/rotates certs, performs mTLS handshake (state: CertReady)
3) operator attaches ENI/updates route tables (state: Routed)
4) operator flips endpoint to Live (state: Live)
Key invariant: operator must not flip to Live unless state == CertReady AND cert_ttl > 10m. If rotator fails we must leave Endpoint Provisioned and be fully idempotent.
jo: incident context — 2025-09-12 we flipped routes while cert rotation lagged ~18m; 3 tenants degraded. Gate on TTL would have stopped that.
sre-bot: alert created: endpoint spends >5m in CertReadyPending => paging. Also suggest metric rotator_latency.
lee: add a signed-ready proof: rotator writes a signed statement (operation_id + cert_fingerprint). operator verifies signature before flipping. Also add --dry-run for rotator to validate flow in staging.
maria: logging/audit: if rotator runs in customer VPC we still need controlplane visibility without leaking keys. Proposed: emit structured events (operation_id, cert_fingerprint, status) only; no private key material.
devops: rotator will assume a role in controlplane account and stream events to Kinesis. We'll provide a least-priv IAM policy.
devex: for private/on-prem we need pluggable key-provider interface: sign(data)->signature and get_pubkey(). We should ship a SoftHSM adapter and an AWS CloudHSM example.
jo: make an offline HSM test harness and a canonical test-vector suite.
amar: rollout plan:
- canary group A (non-SLA tenants) behind feature flag rotator=v2
- dry-run first, validate no route flips
- enable signed-ready gating + TTL gating
- expand to 10% then full
Gates: cert_ttl > 10m, rotator_latency < 30s for canary. Abort expansion on >0.5% egress mismatch.
lee: add an admin force-reverify endpoint that rechecks signature without touching routes.
maria: open tasks (I'll own state machine doc): state diagrams + idempotency examples.
lee: implement signature verification and TTL gating in operator; add dry-run to rotator.
devops: prepare Kinesis role and event schema; need operation_id format by EOD.
devex: HSM interface doc + adapters.
jo: add rollback playbook and quick commands (route-dump, eni-undo, reattach steps) and a list of tenants to exclude for first 2 weeks.
amar: ops notes: propagate operation_id across controlplane/rotator/operator; surface cert_fingerprint and signed_ready in Console per-endpoint; metric endpoint_cutover_failures with tags tenant, region, cause. I'll open RFC + spike PR and announce canary in #eng-oncall.
sre-bot: automated rollback trigger suggestion: if canary egress IP mismatch >0.5% for 10m, rollback.
amar: any objections?
maria: no objections, will draft state machine doc and failure examples.
jo: please include tenant exclusion list in RFC.
devops: will draft IAM snippet once event schema is sent.
devex: will prototype SoftHSM adapter this week.
amar: thanks all :thumbsup:
